redfin.remarks: With a Walk Score of 94—earning the designation of a “Walker’s Paradise”—this 11th-floor residence at Elleven puts some of Downtown Los Angeles’ best shopping, dining, entertainment and transit remarkably close to home. Whole Foods, Ralphs, Target and Zara are just three blocks away, along with Crypto.com Arena and the dining, entertainment and events of L. A. LIVE. The Bloc and the 7th Street/Metro Center transit hub are only two blocks away, while acclaimed restaurants, neighborhood coffee shops and everyday conveniences surround you in every direction. Inside, the residence offers a peaceful retreat from the energy of the city. Set on a quiet upper level overlooking the tranquil pool and sun deck, the home pairs bright blue skies and urban views with the thoughtful, sustainable design for which Elleven is known. High ceilings, organic bamboo flooring and an open floor plan create a bright and exceptionally flexible living space, while the kitchen features modern stainless steel appliances. A private indoor laundry room and deeded parking add everyday convenience. Residents enjoy 24-hour security and a full suite of resort-style outdoor amenities, while the HOA’s prohibition on short-term stays helps preserve the residential character of the community. An exceptional combination of walkability, connectivity and calm in the heart of Downtown Los Angeles.
